raw_segments.text: She went away furiously indignant, while I shouted after her once more that the secret should be kept sacred.
Those two simple creatures, Agafya and her aunt, I may as well say at once, behaved like perfect angels all through this business.
They genuinely adored their Katya, thought her far above them, and waited on her, hand and foot.
But Agafya told her of our conversation. I found that out afterwards. She didn't keep it back, and of course that was all I wanted.
